# Items

Sources: item balls are map objects with script 7000+n, whose item and quantity are set by entry n of the item-ball script file (file 141); hidden items are map background events with script 8000+n, looked up in the hidden-item table in arm9 (`0x020F7194`, 231 entries); gifts are `GiveItem` commands and the "obtain item" standard scripts (2033/2008) with the item resolved from the script; shops are the `SpecialMartBuy` lists in arm9 (`0x0210EAEC`, 54 lists; the hack's command at `0x0204787C` replaces list 3 with a fixed list at `0x020F8B3E`), opened by the clerks' `SetVar 0x8004 <list>; CallStd 2052`. Prices are the item prices in `a/0/1/7`.
